releaseNotes:
Kerlyss 1.4.4-beta.1

Audio & Playback Fixes
- Fixed first song no audio bug on Android (background queue hydration now glides smoothly without buffer reset)
- Fixed Discover double-tap issue on Android (debounced rapid taps to prevent cancelled playback)

UI Parity
- For You recommendations now feature standard menu options (Favorite, Play Next, Add to Queue, Add to Playlist, Loop) in addition to recommendation filters

For Beta Testers
- Settings -> Check for Beta Updates
- Normal check only offers stable
- Beta builds opt-in, same signing key as stable
